notes: Monoprix.fr (SFCC/Demandware, direct HTTP fetch worked, no WAF). Checked: (1) sitemap_3-category.xml (all 188 /c/maison* URLs) grepped for meilleure/best/populaire/tendance/favoris -- zero dedicated bestseller category URL. (2) sitemap_4-content.xml grepped for meilleure/best/vente -- zero hits. (3) Rendered Maison landing page (/c/maison-1) mega-menu JSON (data-levels nav tree) inspected: the only 'Meilleures ventes'/'Best-seller' reference found is a SORT-RULE option (srule=Best-seller) applied via Search-UpdateGrid to whatever arbitrary category id (cgid) the shopper is currently browsing -- e.g. https://www.monoprix.fr/on/demandware.store/Sites-TML-FR-Site/fr_FR/Search-UpdateGrid?cgid=40000&srule=Best-seller -- this reorders an existing category's product grid, it is not a standalone Bestsellers listing/URL of its own. Confirmed by grepping for a distinct category id containing 'best' -- none exists (only the srule param). Per brief Sec.3, an arbitrary sort/filter option applied within another page's PLP does not qualify as its own Bestsellers PLP. No /best-sellers, /bestsellers, /meilleures-ventes, /top-ventes, or equivalent standalone URL exists anywhere in the category or content sitemaps or the Maison mega-menu. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists on this site for the Maison (Home) department (or elsewhere on the site).
